描述_EN: below is a roccoco shield containing the arms of drake, awyvern with wings displayed and tail nowed; the crest is not recorded (in the form of a castle?). the arms could also be of venables (argent a wyvren passant gules). the arms are similar to another, with a different crest, made for the drake family of shardeloes in buckinghamshire and identical to a tea service mae a little later. plate, porcelain, with a rim shaped in four pointed lobes, painted in famille rose enamels and gold with the arms of drake. round the rim is a border of rocaille work in european style with elements of shells and also what appear to be pottery kilns with vents sprouting smoke and cartwheels. these two may have been made for captain richard drake of the hawk, at canton in 1758. in the centre is the design of two pheasants on a rock with peonies.
描述_ZN: below is a roccoco shield containing the arms of drake, awyvern with wings displayed and tail nowed; the crest is not recorded (in the form of a castle?). 该盾牌也可能是Venables的盾牌(argent a wyvren passant gules)。 该徽章与另一个徽章相似，有一个不同的徽章，是为Buckinghamshire的Shardeloes的Drake家族制作的，与稍后制作的一个茶具相同。 盘，瓷器，边缘为四个尖的裂片，用粉彩和金彩绘有德雷克的手臂。 围绕着边缘的是欧洲风格的罗盖尔作品的边框，有贝壳的元素，也有似乎是陶器的窑洞，通风口喷出烟雾和翻转。 这两个可能是为1758年在坎顿的老鹰号船长Richard Drake制作的。 中间是两只野鸡在岩石上与牡丹花的图案。
